title: SITL grounding + current hook (ArduPilot C++)
description: Generic hook so SIM_Sailboat/MotorBoat and SIM_Submarine can query local depth and current from an external source and stop when aground. Design for upstream PR. Unblocks sub currents and land enforcement.
close_reason: SIM_WATER_DEPTH patch: boat grounding, sub seabed + current; driver sends depth at 2 Hz; verified in SITL. Upstreaming: tw-anm

title: Validate forcing against NOAA PORTS observations
description: For the Golden Gate window: compare predicted currents/tide to PORTS observed currents (e.g. s08010 Golden Gate) and wind to PORTS/NDBC met stations. Report error stats in docs.
close_reason: validate command + report; tide now replays observations; wind/current follow-ups tw-7cd tw-xpp

title: SFBOFS currents layer (replace station IDW)
description: Load NOAA SFBOFS FVCOM output from the AWS NODD archive (s3://noaa-nos-ofs-pds/sfbofs) for the scenario window; interpolate on the unstructured mesh, with depth layers. Keeps channels/eddies that station IDW can't represent.

title: Upstream the SIM_WATER_DEPTH patch to ArduPilot
description: patches/ardupilot/0001-*.patch: open a PR against ArduPilot master. Before: check param index 43 in var_info2 was never used (old eeproms), add an autotest (Rover motorboat grounding, Sub floor), discuss armed-only tide gating in SIM_Sailboat with maintainers.

title: Bias-correct HRRR wind with station observations
description: Validation (docs/validation-golden-gate-2026-06.md): HRRR mean +1.1 m/s vs SF 9414290, peaks low, +22 deg direction bias. For replays, nudge the wind field toward station obs (speed scale + direction offset, decaying with distance). Mind anemometer height/exposure.

title: Validate current interpolation where a meter exists
description: No active PORTS current meter inside the Golden Gate box in June 2026. Validate the method (prediction + IDW) at s09010 Oakland Outer Harbor or s08010 Southampton Shoal with a scenario that includes them, to quantify interpolation error.

title: Quicklook map: land mask + current arrows at time t
description: tidewater map SCENARIO --at T -> PNG/HTML for sanity checks and demos (matplotlib).

title: Gazebo world generator from DEM
description: Terrain + seabed meshes/heightmaps and coastline from terrain.npz for a scenario; BlueBoat/VRX compatible.

title: Gazebo: check environmental-data support
description: Verify whether current Gazebo (Harmonic+) can load spatially/temporally varying environment data from file and apply it in hydrodynamics. Decides whether the Gazebo adapter is an exporter or a plugin.

title: Second scenario (Tampa Bay or Puget Sound)
description: Prove scenarios are data, not code. Tampa: real-boat validation option; Puget: deep water for subs.

title: Tide spatial variation across the area
description: Use several tide stations (CO-OPS) or SFBOFS water level instead of one reference station.
